Title: Verify login page displays all required elements on load
Precondition: The OrangeHRM QA login page is reachable and the browser has no active OrangeHRM session.
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login → Expected: The login page loads without errors | 2. Observe the branding area → Expected: The OrangeHRM logo/branding is displayed | 3. Observe the form fields → Expected: A Username input field and a Password input field are both visible | 4. Observe the action controls → Expected: A 'Login' button and a 'Forgot your password?' link are both visible
Expected Result: The login page displays the OrangeHRM logo, Username field, Password field, Login button, and Forgot your password? link.

Title: Verify successful login with valid credentials redirects to Dashboard
Precondition: A registered user account exists with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123'. The login page is reachable and no session is currently active.
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login → Expected: Login form is displayed with Username and Password fields and a Login button | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the Username field → Expected: The Username field shows 'Admin'; no validation error appears | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the Password field → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters; no validation error appears | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: The user is redirected to the Dashboard page (/web/index.php/dashboard/index) within 3 seconds | 5. Observe the Dashboard header and session cookie → Expected: The Dashboard content is displayed and a session cookie is set for the authenticated user
Expected Result: The user is authenticated, a valid session is created, and the Dashboard is displayed within 3 seconds.

Title: Verify login fails with an incorrect password for a valid username
Precondition: A registered user account exists with username 'Admin'. The login page is reachable with no active session.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: Login form is displayed | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the Username field → Expected: The Username field shows 'Admin' | 3. Enter 'WrongPass999' into the Password field → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: An 'Invalid credentials' error message is displayed and the user remains on the login page; no redirect to Dashboard occurs
Expected Result: The system displays 'Invalid credentials' and the user is not authenticated.

Title: Verify identical 'Invalid credentials' message for unknown username and for wrong password
Precondition: Username 'Admin' is a valid registered account and username 'NoSuchUser2024' does not exist. Login page reachable with no active session.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page and log in with username 'NoSuchUser2024' and password 'WrongPass999' by clicking 'Login' → Expected: An error message is displayed on the login page; capture the exact text | 2. Reload the login page and log in with valid username 'Admin' and password 'WrongPass999' by clicking 'Login' → Expected: An error message is displayed on the login page; capture the exact text | 3. Compare the two captured error messages → Expected: Both messages read exactly 'Invalid credentials' with no difference that reveals whether the username exists
Expected Result: Both failure scenarios display the identical 'Invalid credentials' message, preventing username enumeration.

Title: Verify 'Required' validation for blank Username, blank Password, and both blank
Precondition: The login page is reachable with no active session and both fields are empty.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page and, with both fields empty, click the 'Login' button → Expected: A 'Required' message is displayed under both the Username and Password fields; no redirect occurs | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the Username field, leave Password empty, and click 'Login' → Expected: A 'Required' message is displayed under the Password field only; no redirect occurs | 3. Reload the page, leave Username empty, enter 'admin123' into the Password field, and click 'Login' → Expected: A 'Required' message is displayed under the Username field only; no redirect occurs
Expected Result: The system displays 'Required' for each empty mandatory field and authentication never proceeds.

Title: Verify password characters are masked on screen while typing
Precondition: The login page is reachable with no active session.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: Login form is displayed | 2. Type 'admin123' into the Password field → Expected: Each character is rendered as a masking dot/bullet, not as plain text | 3. Inspect the Password field's input type attribute → Expected: The input type is 'password' so the value is masked and not readable on screen
Expected Result: The password is displayed as masked characters and never rendered as plain text on screen.

Title: Verify leading and trailing spaces in Username are trimmed before validation
Precondition: A registered account exists with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123'. Login page reachable with no active session.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: Login form is displayed | 2. Enter '  Admin  ' (with two leading and two trailing spaces) into the Username field → Expected: The padded value is accepted into the field | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the Password field → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: The trimmed username 'Admin' is used for validation and the user is redirected to the Dashboard
Expected Result: Username whitespace is trimmed and authentication succeeds as if 'Admin' had been entered.

Title: Verify Password is NOT trimmed and surrounding spaces are treated as significant
Precondition: A registered account exists with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123'. Login page reachable with no active session.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: Login form is displayed | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the Username field → Expected: The Username field shows 'Admin' | 3. Enter ' admin123 ' (with one leading and one trailing space) into the Password field → Expected: The padded value is accepted and shown masked | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: An 'Invalid credentials' error is displayed because the spaces are treated as significant; the user is not authenticated
Expected Result: The password spaces are preserved, the credential does not match, and 'Invalid credentials' is displayed.

Title: Verify pressing Enter in the Password field triggers login equivalent to clicking Login
Precondition: A registered account exists with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123'. Login page reachable with no active session.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: Login form is displayed | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the Username field → Expected: The Username field shows 'Admin' | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the Password field and leave focus in that field → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters and retains focus | 4. Press the Enter key → Expected: The login process is triggered once and the user is redirected to the Dashboard, identical to clicking 'Login'
Expected Result: Pressing Enter submits the login form once and authenticates the user, landing on the Dashboard.

Title: Verify pressing Enter with empty fields triggers the same 'Required' validation as clicking Login
Precondition: The login page is reachable with no active session and both fields are empty.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: Login form is displayed with both fields empty | 2. Click into the Username field to place focus without typing anything → Expected: The Username field has focus and remains empty | 3. Press the Enter key → Expected: A 'Required' message is displayed under both the Username and Password fields and no authentication request is sent
Expected Result: Enter with empty fields triggers 'Required' validation identically to clicking Login, with no silent no-op.

Title: Verify 'Forgot your password?' link navigates to the Password Reset page
Precondition: The login page is reachable with no active session.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: Login form is displayed with a 'Forgot your password?' link visible | 2. Click the 'Forgot your password?' link → Expected: The browser navigates to the Password Reset page (/web/index.php/auth/requestPasswordResetCode) | 3. Observe the Password Reset page → Expected: A Reset Password form is displayed with a Username field and Reset/Cancel controls
Expected Result: The user is navigated to the Password Reset page where recovery can be initiated.

Title: Verify returning to Login from the Password Reset page shows a clean, empty form
Precondition: The login page is reachable with no active session.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page and click the 'Forgot your password?' link → Expected: The Password Reset page is displayed | 2. Click the 'Cancel' control on the Password Reset page → Expected: The browser returns to the login page | 3. Inspect the Username and Password fields on the returned login page → Expected: Both fields are empty and no validation errors or prior state are retained
Expected Result: Returning to Login shows a clean, empty form with no retained sensitive state.

Title: Verify direct access to a protected page without a session redirects to Login
Precondition: No OrangeHRM session is active; browser cookies for the site have been cleared.
Steps: 1. Clear cookies and directly navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/dashboard/index → Expected: The application does not render Dashboard content | 2. Observe the resulting URL and page → Expected: The browser is redirected to the login page (/web/index.php/auth/login) with the login form displayed
Expected Result: Unauthenticated access to the Dashboard is blocked and the user is redirected to Login.

Title: Verify browser Back after logout does not re-expose an authenticated Dashboard
Precondition: A registered account exists with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123'.
Steps: 1. Log in with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123' and confirm the Dashboard is displayed → Expected: The Dashboard loads with an active session | 2. Log out via the user menu 'Logout' option → Expected: The session is terminated and the login page is displayed | 3. Press the browser Back button → Expected: The Dashboard is not re-displayed as authenticated; the user is redirected to or kept on the login page and cannot access protected content
Expected Result: Back navigation after logout does not re-expose authenticated content and requires re-login.

Title: Verify session cookie is issued with Secure and HttpOnly flags on login
Precondition: A registered account exists with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123'. The site is served over HTTPS.
Steps: 1. Open browser developer tools and record the cookies present before login → Expected: No authenticated session cookie is present | 2. Log in with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123' → Expected: The Dashboard loads and a session cookie is created | 3. Inspect the session cookie attributes in developer tools → Expected: The session cookie has the HttpOnly and Secure flags set | 4. Compare the session identifier value before and after login → Expected: A new session ID is issued at login (differs from any pre-login value), mitigating session fixation
Expected Result: The session cookie is Secure and HttpOnly and a fresh session ID is issued on login.

Title: Verify credentials are submitted over HTTPS in the POST body and not in the URL
Precondition: A registered account exists with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123'. Browser network capture is enabled.
Steps: 1. Open browser developer tools Network tab and navigate to the login page over HTTPS → Expected: The page is served via https:// with a valid certificate | 2. Log in with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123' and capture the authentication request → Expected: A login request is sent to the server | 3. Inspect the request URL and payload → Expected: The request uses HTTPS and the password appears only in the POST body, never in the URL query string
Expected Result: Credentials are transmitted over HTTPS in the request body and never exposed in the URL.

Title: Verify script injection input in Username is sanitized and does not execute
Precondition: The login page is reachable with no active session.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: Login form is displayed | 2. Enter the value <script>alert('xss')</script> into the Username field → Expected: The raw text is accepted into the field without triggering any script | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the Password field and click 'Login' → Expected: No JavaScript alert dialog appears; the input is handled as text and an 'Invalid credentials' error is displayed
Expected Result: The script payload is sanitized/rejected as invalid input and never executes.

Title: Verify SQL injection attempt in credentials is prevented and does not authenticate
Precondition: The login page is reachable with no active session.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page → Expected: Login form is displayed | 2. Enter ' OR '1'='1 into the Username field → Expected: The value is accepted as literal text | 3. Enter ' OR '1'='1 into the Password field and click 'Login' → Expected: Authentication does not succeed; an 'Invalid credentials' error is displayed and no redirect to Dashboard occurs
Expected Result: The SQL injection attempt is prevented, the user is not authenticated, and 'Invalid credentials' is shown.

Title: Verify Username boundary lengths of 1 and 100 characters are accepted for validation
Precondition: The login page is reachable with no active session.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page and enter the single character 'A' into the Username field → Expected: The single-character value is accepted without a length validation error | 2. Enter 'admin123' into the Password field and click 'Login' → Expected: The field is processed and an authentication result is returned (no length rejection); 'Invalid credentials' is acceptable since 'A' is not a valid account | 3. Reload the page and enter a 100-character string of 'a' into the Username field, then enter 'admin123' and click 'Login' → Expected: The 100-character value is accepted without a length validation error and an authentication result is returned
Expected Result: Both 1-character and 110-character usernames are accepted for validation without length errors at the boundaries.
